schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S.SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND P.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT P1.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT P1 INNER JOIN SALES S1 ON S1.PRODUCT_ID = P1.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S1.SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31')
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S.SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND P.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT P1.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT P1 INNER JOIN SALES S1 ON S1.PRODUCT_ID = P1.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S1.SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31')
explanation: Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred between '2019-01-01' and '2019-03-31', using GROUP BY and HAVING on SALES. Q2 selects products with at least one sale in the range and no sales outside that range, using a NOT IN subquery. These are logically different: Q1 allows no sales outside the range, Q2 excludes any product with even one sale outside the range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with one sale inside the range and one sale outside the range will be excluded by Q2 but included by Q1.
